name: qa-analyst
description: Analysis-only assistant for QA: answers questions about tickets, linked requirements, logs, the database and the code in conversation, and writes a report in the formats you pick (summary, test cases, impact, decision table, log statistics, regression scope, Confluence page, visual page) only when you ask. No code examples, never changes code.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: In every report: the answer and next steps (00-README.md), business flow charts (03-flows.md), findings with evidence and requirements coverage (04-findings.md), ready-to-paste ticket notes (06-ticket-notes.md).

tests.title: Test cases
tests.description: In every report, 05-test-cases.md: test cases TC-* with requirements, type, priority, preconditions, test data and steps with an expected result on each step.

impact.title: Impact in numbers
impact.description: In every report, 07-impact.md: how many records, users and partners are affected, counted in the database (a SELECT behind every number), by status, partner and day, with conclusions on size, trend and priority.

decision_table.title: Decision table
decision_table.description: In every report, 08-decision-table.md: every combination of conditions with the expected result from the requirements and today's result, the status transitions, the gaps in the requirements, with conclusions.

logs.title: Log statistics
logs.description: In every report, 09-log-stats.md: errors by type and hour, first and last time, share of requests, lined up with deploys and commits, with conclusions. Only when the task has logs.

regression.title: Regression scope
regression.description: In every report, 10-regression.md: what changed in the code between two releases or commits, which business areas it touches, what to retest in which order, a checklist, with conclusions on the risk.

visual_artifact.title: Visual page (Artifact)
visual_artifact.description: In every report, build an interactive page (verdict, flows, timeline, requirements, checklist of test cases) and publish it as a private Artifact on claude.ai. Personal data is masked before publishing.

confluence_page.title: Confluence-style page
confluence_page.description: In every report, write confluence-page.md: a plain overview for BA, PM and the team, ready to paste into Confluence. Nothing is published.
